name: batched-pointer-setup
algorithm: Build device arrays of per-batch matrix pointers so cuBLAS batched GEMM and similar helpers can consume ggml tensor batches with broadcasted strides.

inputs.name: base tensor pointers and stride metadata

notes: Skipped for a non-difficulty reason. k_compute_batched_ptrs is a CUDA-internal helper that builds per-batch pointer arrays for cuBLAS batched GEMM. The SYCL backend's oneMKL batched GEMM path in ggml/src/ggml-sycl/mmf.cpp uses GEMM_BATCH with strided batch metadata and does not need manual pointer-array setup, so the functionality is already covered by the migrated batched MUL_MAT path.
